title: Six docs still need the prose pass
description:
Mark 2026-11-27 asked for the prose pass over every human-readable doc. Twelve were done. These six were held back because they carried uncommitted changes belonging to the telemetry, refusal, keepalive and span commits, and rewriting their prose then would have mixed a prose pass into each of those: AGENTS.md, docs/agent.md, docs/operating.md, docs/irc-lessons.md, docs/design/agent-frontends.md, docs/design/binary-live-stream.md.

agent-frontends.md is the one to be most careful with: its section numbers are cited 146 times across source comments and docs, and 33 beads point into it. The brief and the invariant checker are in the session scratchpad; the rule is that no heading text, heading number or section order changes and no fact, citation, table row or Uncertainties entry is lost.

CLAUDE.md needs nothing: seven lines that include AGENTS.md and name the issue tracker.
